# 4 Ezra Chapter 15 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** 6th Ezra (Christian addition)

---

**1** Behold, speak in the ears of my people the words of prophecy which I will put in your mouth, says the LORD.

**2** And cause them to be written on paper; for they are trustworthy and true.

**3** Fear not the thoughts against you; let not the unbelief of those who speak against you trouble you.

**4** For every unbeliever shall die in his unbelief.

**5** Behold, says the LORD, I bring evils upon the world — the sword, famine, death, and destruction;

**6** because iniquity has polluted the whole earth, and their harmful deeds are fulfilled.

**7** Therefore says the LORD:

**8** I will hold my peace no more concerning their ungodly deeds, which they commit in their ungodliness, neither will I endure those things which they practice in wickedness; behold, the blood of the innocent and righteous cries out to me, and the souls of the righteous cry out continually.

**9** I will surely avenge them, says the LORD, and I will receive unto me all the innocent blood from among them.

**10** Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt;

**11** but I will bring them out with a mighty hand and with a high arm, and I will smite Egypt with plagues as formerly, and will destroy all her land.

**12** Let Egypt mourn, and her foundations, because of the plague of chastisement and punishment that God shall bring upon her.

**13** Let the farmers that till the ground mourn, because their seeds shall fail through blasting and hail and with a fearful constellation.

**14** Woe to the world and to those who dwell therein!

**15** For the sword and their destruction draw nigh, and nation shall rise up against nation to battle with weapons in their hands.

**16** For there shall be sedition among men, and waxing strong one against another, they shall not regard their king nor the chief of their great ones, in their might.

**17** For a man shall desire to go into a city and shall not be able.

**18** For because of their pride the cities shall be troubled, the houses shall be destroyed, and men shall be afraid.

**19** A man shall have no pity on his neighbor, but shall assault their houses with the sword and plunder their goods, because of hunger for bread and because of great tribulation.

**20** Behold, says my God, I call together all the kings of the earth to fear me — those from the rising of the sun, and from the south, and from the east, and Libanus —

**21** to turn themselves one against another, and repay to them what they have dealt to others.

**22** Like as they do even now to my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense it in their bosom. Thus says the LORD God:

**23** My right hand shall not spare the sinners, and my sword shall not cease over those who shed innocent blood upon the earth.

**24** And fire is gone forth from his wrath, and has consumed the foundations of the earth and the sinners, like the burning of straw.

**25** Woe to them that sin and keep not my commandments! says the LORD.

**26** I will not spare them: go your way, you rebellious children, defile not my sanctuary.

**27** For the LORD knows all those who sin against him, and therefore he delivers them to death and destruction.

**28** For now are the calamities come upon the whole earth, and you shall remain in them: for God shall not deliver you, because you have sinned against him.

**29** Behold a vision horrible, and the appearance thereof from the east!

**30** Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon the earth, that all who hear them may fear and tremble.

**31** Also the Carmonians raging in wrath shall go forth as wild boars out of the forest, and with great power shall they come and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.

**32** And then shall the dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature; and if they turn themselves, conspiring together in great power to pursue them,

**33** then these shall be troubled and keep silence through their power, and shall flee.

**34** And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy beset them in ambush, and shall destroy one of them, and fear and trembling shall come upon their host, and indecision upon their kings.

**35** Behold clouds from the east and from the north even unto the south, and they are very horrible to look upon, full of wrath and tempest.

**36** They shall smite one against another, and they shall smite down a great multitude of stars upon the earth, even their own star; and blood shall be from the sword unto the belly,

**37** and dung of men unto the camel's hough.

**38** And there shall be great fearfulness and trembling upon earth: and those who see that wrath shall be afraid, and trembling shall take hold upon them.

**39** And after this shall great storms be stirred up from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west.

**40** And strong winds shall arise from the east, and shall shut it up, and the cloud which he raised up in wrath, and the star stirred to cause fear toward the east and west wind, shall be destroyed.

**41** There shall be great and mighty clouds, full of wrath, and the star, that they may make all the earth afraid and those who dwell therein; and they shall pour out over every high and eminent place a horrible star,

**42** fire and hail and flying swords and many waters, that all fields may be full, and all rivers, with the abundance of those waters.

**43** And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.

**44** And they shall go up steadily even to heaven, and all the stars shall fall down, and mourning shall be great in heaven and among the stars, for the stars shall be troubled exceedingly.

**45** And there shall come great fear upon them from the east: the great strong dragon, for he shall come in the fury of his spirit, and with a flaming fire shall he lead them.

**46** And there shall be a conflagration in the lands through which he shall pass, and also in that which is left over from them; and then shall these see him and be afraid.

**47** And the cities of Egypt shall come together, not all but many, trembling and fearing before his face, and they shall bring him incense and gifts.

**48** And he shall be terrible in his wrath against them, so that they shall depart in peace.

**49** And there shall go a great storm over the sea, and the waves shall be troubled, and the fish thereof also, before the face of the LORD and before the glory of his power.

**50** For there shall be great fear and trembling on the earth: and those who see his wrath shall tremble, and trembling shall take hold upon them.

**51** And then shall great clouds be moved and gathered together with wrath, and the star shall pass and fill all the earth with fear; and those who dwell therein shall tremble, and no place shall be left that is at peace.

**52** And the war shall begin on every side, and every man shall have weapons in his hands.

**53** For those who fear God shall not put on armor but shall escape like clouds driven before wind and hail; but the wicked shall perish and be consumed as a fire consumes them.

**54** Woe to those who sin and do not observe my commandments, says the LORD.

**55** For I will not trouble myself to save them, because I will bring evils upon those who have not obeyed the law of God.

**56** Behold the vision of my judgment against them! For I shall make them go wailing into the desert and there leave them.

**57** And their bones shall be scattered over the plain, and there shall be no remedy for them; for thus says the LORD.

**58** For as fire burns the stubble that it leaves none, so shall you be left with no remnant.

**59** And as for you who have been haughty against those who fear God, hear now my word:

**60** For the LORD is ready to destroy you; a sword is readied for you, and if you see not the vision written against you, it is because God is slow to anger and his grace is great and plentiful.

**61** No one shall escape the judgment of the Most High, save only those who keep his commandments.

**62** Lo therefore, you who have been too proud toward those who fear God, thus says the LORD God:

**63** I will bring calamity upon all those who have hated my people, and in one day I will destroy all the land that the wicked have contaminated with their power.
